text:
alex: Quick ask — I have a tiny SDK snippet PR (2 files, ~8 lines) that fixes a param example and updates a link. CI docs preview is flapping, can't get a stable preview. Who can pick up review + merge before EOD? I'm out on call tomorrow morning.

marta: @alex can you paste the PR link and the failing preview? I can take a look in an hour.

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — docs-bot posted preview but it times out intermittently. Error is `preview build error: fetch-assets TIMEOUT`.

docs-bot: Preview ready: https://preview.redwood.dev/4821 (intermittent failures noted, requeued builds: 3)

josh: @marta I can review too if you end up on other stuff. If it's genuinely <10 lines, we usually do 1 reviewer + staging verification and merge in the next merge window.

marta: Sounds fine. @alex can you drop the small repro steps for the snippet so I can sanity-check?

alex: Sure — just run `yarn docs:preview` locally then visit `/sdk/js/examples`. The snippet shows `client.generate({model: 'open-redwood-1', prompt: ...})` (should be `client.responses.create`). Also fixed a broken link to the batching guide.

riley: Heads up I'm OOO this afternoon so can't take it. If docs-bot preview keeps failing, we sometimes bypass by verifying locally + CI green on lint/tests. Is there a lint/test status on the PR?

docs-bot: CI status: lint ✅, unit-tests ✅, docs-preview ⚠️ (3 retries). Merge checks remaining: docs-preview.

josh: Given lint + tests green and it's a clear example fix, I'm fine approving if Marta signs off on content. We can ask eng-sre to nudge the preview pipeline if we need a fresh run. @marta ok to approve after your quick check?
marta: Yes — I'll check the snippet and the link. If everything's good I will post `LGTM` and you can merge after the preview succeeds or after we confirm local preview and re-run preview once.
alex: Appreciate it. If the preview times out again, can we do a manual merge with a note in the PR body and create a follow-up ticket to debug preview flakiness?
josh: That sounds reasonable. Add a short note: "manual merge due to flaky docs-preview; follow-up: DEVOPS-1705".
marta: Found the issue in the snippet — old method name and missing await. Suggest patch: ```js
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: 'open-redwood-1', input: 'hello' })
console.log(resp.output_text)
```
alex: Pushed the small fix. Thanks!
docs-bot: New preview triggered: https://preview.redwood.dev/4821 (attempt 4)
riley: :eyes: I won't block this. If preview still fails on attempt 4, merge with the follow-up ticket note and ping infra.
marta: Preview is green for me now, content looks good. Posting `LGTM` and adding the follow-up ticket link in the PR description. :shipit:
josh: Approved. Alex, you can merge in the next merge window or merge now if it's a patch and doesn't touch shared content.
alex: Merged. PR closed. Thanks everyone. I'll file DEVOPS-1705 for the flaky preview queue.
docs-bot: PR #4821 merged by alex — changelog updated.
